title: City Bonds, Fire Upgrades, & Citizen Relief
summary:
*   **City Bond Election Approved:** An ordinance passed to hold an election for issuing new city bonds, despite internal concerns about the city's current debt load and the difficulty of selling bonds during the period of "distress and uncertainty."
*   **Fire Department Boost:** New leadership appointments were made, including an Assistant Fire Chief, and a contract was awarded for 1,000 feet of specialized fire hose to enhance firefighting capabilities.
*   **Citizen Appeals & Infrastructure:** Several residents received extensions to connect to the city's sanitary sewer system, and the council remitted portions or all of fines for various minor offenses, including "fishing with two poles" and "drunkenness."

Fire Hose
Contract
awarded
The Mayor laid before the Council the following resolution : Whereas, on this day came on
to be considered propositions from five firms or Corporations ,by their respective agents
,for the supply of one thousand feet of fire hose to the City of Austin, Texas, at various
prices according to the quality of the hose ,from $ 1.30 per running foot down to 60 ½
cents per running foot ; and Whereas, the City Council has come to the unanimous
conclusion that for the purposes of our present needs more than averagelsstrong hose for
the use of our automatic pumping engine is required; and Whereas, such requirement would
seem to indicate to the City Council that it should be best that we purchase what is known
as Solid Multiple Woven hose ; and Whereas , there wer only two corporations offering this
quality of fire hose; and Whereas, the price of the Baker Fabric hose,as offered to the
City Council by the corporation of Walter Co of this City, being to-wit,four ply Baker
Fabric solid multiple hose at $ 1.15 per running foot without couplings,is the lowest and
best price offered for said above described hose; Now, therefore, Be it resolved by the
City Council of the City of Austin,Texas: That the City Council hereby authorizes Clarence
Woodward ,Chief of the Fire Department, to contract for the furnishing to the City of
Austin of one thousandfeet of Solid Multiple Woven Hose ,to be furnished this City within
a reasonable time at the cost of $ 1.15 per running foot ,without couplings,to be paid for
on or before February 1st 1918, without interest upon the amount owing for such purpose.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote: Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Anthony, Haynes & Powell 4 Nays none,
Approved, A P Wooldridge, Mayor.
